On Yahoo Finance, you can view its detailed profile, price chart, financials, news, and analyst estimates by visiting:

[https://finance.yahoo.com/quote/MSFT](https://finance.yahoo.com/quote/MSFT)

This page shows:

- Current stock price and performance
- Historical data
- Key statistics (market cap, P/E ratio, dividend yield, etc.)
- Financial statements (income statement, balance sheet, cash flow)
- Analyst ratings and target prices
- Recent news articles and earnings releases

If you need more specific information (e.g., latest earnings, dividend history, or sector classification), let me know!
